rca of the issue: The main agent's stated fix (deletion of the mousedown outside-click useEffect in Header.jsx) was never persisted to the file. Lines 75-82 still contain the document-level mousedown listener that calls setMenuOpen(false) whenever the event target is outside menuRef. Because the dropdown is rendered via ReactDOM.createPortal into document.body, the portalled menu items are outside menuRef's subtree, so their mousedown is treated as an outside click, the menu is closed, the portal is unmounted, and the pending click never dispatches to the button. Reproduction: login as admin (admin/admin123), click header-profile, click any menu item — nothing happens. Fix: physically delete the useEffect at lines 75-82 (the transparent [data-testid=header-profile-overlay] div already provides outside-click closure) and verify with grep.
